cases.sql: CREATE TYPE mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'happy')
CREATE DOMAIN positive AS integer CHECK (VALUE > 0)
CREATE TABLE feelings (id integer, m mood, note text, amount numeric, flag boolean, tags integer[])
CREATE TABLE audit (id integer, note text)
CREATE TABLE lookup (id integer)
CREATE SCHEMA hidden
CREATE TABLE hidden.events (id integer)
CREATE FUNCTION log_row() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO audit VALUES (NEW.id, TG_NAME); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE RULE plain_rule AS ON UPDATE TO feelings WHERE NEW.id > 5 DO ALSO INSERT INTO audit VALUES (NEW.id)
CREATE RULE instead_rule AS ON DELETE TO feelings DO INSTEAD (INSERT INTO audit VALUES (OLD.id, 'deleted'); UPDATE audit SET id = OLD.id WHERE id = 0)
CREATE RULE nothing_rule AS ON INSERT TO feelings WHERE NEW.note = 'skip' DO INSTEAD NOTHING
CREATE RULE mood_rule AS ON UPDATE TO feelings WHERE NEW.m = 'happy' AND OLD.m <> NEW.m DO ALSO INSERT INTO audit (id, note) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.m::text)
CREATE RULE subquery_rule AS ON INSERT TO feelings WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lookup WHERE lookup.id = NEW.id) DO ALSO DELETE FROM audit WHERE audit.id = NEW.id
CREATE RULE select_rule AS ON INSERT TO feelings DO ALSO INSERT INTO audit (id, note) SELECT NEW.id, 'copied'
CREATE RULE case_rule AS ON UPDATE TO feelings WHERE CASE WHEN NEW.flag THEN NEW.amount > 1.5 ELSE false END DO ALSO UPDATE audit SET note = upper(NEW.note) WHERE audit.id = NEW.id
CREATE RULE "Mixed Rule" AS ON DELETE TO hidden.events DO ALSO DELETE FROM audit WHERE audit.id = OLD.id
CREATE RULE notify_rule AS ON INSERT TO audit DO ALSO NOTIFY audit_channel
CREATE RULE payload_rule AS ON UPDATE TO audit DO ALSO (NOTIFY audit_channel, 'it''s updated'; INSERT INTO lookup VALUES (NEW.id))
